# Evidence: sales and outreach frameworks

Ratings: **Measured** (study or large dataset with a stated method; "vendor, observational" when the publisher
sells the thing measured), **Survey** (stated sample, self-reported), **Practice** (a named practitioner's
documented method), **Vendor** (a seller's claim about its own method or product, no method published),
**Untraced** (no primary source found, or the source does not say it). Every URL is in `sources.md`.

## Frameworks with research behind them

| Claim | Source | Rating |
|---|---|---|
| SPIN came from about 35,000 observed sales calls over 12 years in 20+ countries (Wikipedia); "10,000 salespeople in 23 countries" is the book's introduction, seen only through a search summary | Wikipedia; book introduction (not read) | Measured (by the method's owner; raw data unpublished). The Huthwaite blog itself does not state 35,000: it appears there only inside a skeptic's question |
| Observers were trained to a 0.85 correlation with standard tapes | Huthwaite blog | Measured (method description by the owner) |
| "The first thousand trained on SPIN had 17% higher sales volume than control groups": in the Huthwaite blog this is voiced as what skeptics say he claims; Rackham neither confirms nor disputes the number, only the cause ("the whole coaching process", not the four questions) | Huthwaite blog | Untraced (number not asserted by the source; no study details) |
| Methods for small sales do not carry over to large sales | Rackham via publisher and summaries | Measured in origin; read only in summaries |

| Challengers do best in complex sales (the "54%" figure) | Summaries | Untraced number; direction Survey |

|---|---|---|

| "Have you given up trying to deal with this problem?" as a funnel question | Gong guide | Practice |
| Gap Selling: current state (environment, problem, impact, root cause, emotion), future state, gap | Gong guide | Practice |
| Build a problem identification chart before outreach | Gong guide | Practice |
| Top reps talk 46%, listen 54%; average reps 68:32 | Gong, quoted in its Gap Selling guide | Measured (vendor, calls, not messages) |

| ValueSelling: 35% more licences, 10x order size, 63%, 500% revenue | ValueSelling home page | Vendor |
| Command of the Message: before scenario, negative consequences, PBOs, required capabilities, metrics | Secondary summaries; Force Management blog | Practice (component count disputed) |
